title: Other old-time drummers: Manetta, Brundy, Bolegs and Claiborne Williams
summary: Asked about old drummers, Robertson says he knew Manetta, only heard of Walter Brundy, and describes Bolegs from Donaldsonville, who married Claiborne Williams' daughter.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah, I know. Did you know Manetta? Mania Manetta?
Oh, speaking about the old-time drummers, did you ever know or see Meg Murray or Diddy Channel?
No, I didn't remember. I heard of him. Walter Brundy. Walter Brundy. He was another old-timer. I heard of him. Walter Brundy.
Walter Brundy, he was another old-timer.
I heard him tell about sometimes.
I guess he's way back. Yeah, I think he left here pretty young and he was killed up in Baton Rouge or someplace. Yeah, I heard of those.

50 years ago, 40. Now, they had a fella used to come here out of Donifanville. He used to be here a lot of times. He was a great drummer too, called Bolegs, but he didn't belong here. Bolegs? Yeah, he used to play that band in Donifanville, that great band there in Donifanville, but he didn't belong here. When he came here, them bands were high. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Bolegs, great drummer.
Did he ever play with the Claiborne Williams band? Yeah. That's the best with his drummer. Oh, it was his drummer.
That's the drummer, Claiborne Williams. He married Claiborne Williams' daughter.
You never knew him by any other name? Never knew him by any other name.
He married his daughter. Claiborne Williams' daughter. That's right. Yeah.
